title: Oven-Smoked Malaysian Lamb Kidney Satay
description: A rich, smoky lamb kidney dish infused with coconut and spices, perfect for easing a hangover and satisfying a craving for bold flavors.
instructions: Preheat oven to 120°C and place soaked applewood chips in a small pan to create smoke.
In a bowl, whisk together coconut milk, soy sauce, lime juice, grated ginger, minced garlic, turmeric, coriander, cumin, chili flakes, salt, and pepper to make a sauce.
Pat kidneys dry, then coat them with the sauce mixture thoroughly.
Thread the kidneys onto skewers, leaving a small gap between each piece.
Arrange the skewers on a baking sheet lined with foil and bake for 30 minutes, turning halfway through.
While cooking, sprinkle a pinch of ground chili flakes over the kidneys for extra heat.
Remove from oven and let the kidneys rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve hot with fresh cucumber slices and a side of coconut yogurt dip.
